en.headline: PAG agrees to buy 51 per cent of Evergrande Property Services for HK$4 billion
en.dek: The private equity firm will take control of the listed unit at a discount, marking progress in liquidators' efforts to recover assets for China Evergrande creditors.
body: Asia-focused investment firm PAG has agreed to acquire a 51 per cent stake in Evergrande Property Services Group for HK$4.03 billion, according to a joint announcement filed with the Hong Kong stock exchange on Friday.

The offer price is set at HK$0.8359 per share, representing a 29.5 per cent discount to the last closing price before the stock was suspended. PAG will become the new controlling shareholder upon completion.

The deal is part of efforts by the liquidators of China Evergrande Group to sell assets and recover funds for creditors. The company said taking control of the services unit would remove uncertainty tied to the parent group's liquidation and could strengthen market confidence.
Trading in Evergrande Property Services shares resumed on Friday and the stock fell about 13.5 per cent. PAG said it would fund the acquisition with financing and equity from its funds.

zh.headline: PAG同意以40億元收購恒大物業51%股權
zh.dek: 私募基金將以折讓價取得上市單位控制權，標誌着清盤人為中國恒大債權人追回資產的努力取得進展。
body: 聚焦亞洲的投資公司PAG同意以40.3億港元收購恒大物業服務集團51%股權，雙方周五向香港交易所提交的聯合公告如是說。
要約價定為每股0.8359港元，較停牌前最後收市價折讓29.5%。交易完成後，PAG將成為新控股股東。
是項交易屬中國恒大集團清盤人出售資產、為債權人追回資金努力的一部分。公司表示，取得服務單位控制權可消除與母公司清盤相關的不確定性，或有助增強市場信心。
恒大物業服務股份周五復牌後下跌約13.5%。PAG表示將以融資及基金股本支付收購代價。
